pages.text: Difficulty gates modifiers and influences their random chances.$(br2)$(li)0–14: no modifier is enabled.$(li)15+: material gear/plate substitutions.$(li)25+: extra crafting ingredients.$(li)75+: EMC-filtered ingredient swaps.$(br2)Eligible recipes are not all guaranteed to change.

pages.title: Recipe Types
pages.text: Ingredient swaps and additions use ProjectE EMC comparisons and dependency checks. This does not prove that every generated progression path is obtainable.$(br2)Handlers cover shaped/shapeless crafting, smelting, blasting, smoking, campfire cooking, stonecutting and smithing. Other mods’ custom machine recipe types are outside those handlers.
